description: Partner tree node detail view for administrative management of organizational hierarchies. Allows viewing and editing partner tree structure, relationships, and hierarchical data.

pages.name: PartnerTreeDetailsComponent
pages.description: This page provides a detailed view of a specific node within the partner organizational tree. It is designed for administrators to manage and configure organizational hierarchies, relationships, and associated data. Users can review existing details, modify hierarchical positioning, and update organizational information.

search.description: Search functionality is not directly available on this detail page, as it focuses on a single record. To find a specific partner tree node, use the search or filtering options on the main partner tree listing page.
search.help_text: Navigate to the main Partner Tree view to search for specific nodes.

help_guidance.when_stuck: This page displays detailed information about a specific node in your organization's partner tree. If you're unsure what to do, review the displayed fields to understand the node's current configuration. You can modify the data in the available fields to update organizational details, relationships, or its position within the hierarchy. Remember that any changes you save here will directly impact how this partner appears in organizational charts and other hierarchical views across the system.
common_tasks: Viewing tree node details: To understand the current setup of a partner, simply review the information displayed on the page, including its organizational data and relationships.

Editing organizational data: To update details like the partner's name, description, or other relevant attributes, locate the corresponding fields and enter the new information. Ensure all mandatory fields are completed.

Managing relationships: To change the parent-child relationships within the organization tree (e.g., assigning a new parent or child node), use the designated fields or controls that define hierarchical links.
Configuring hierarchy: To adjust the organizational positioning and reporting lines of this node, modify the fields that dictate its place in the overall tree structure.

Updating structure: To make changes to how the organization is represented in the system, update the relevant fields and save your changes. This ensures the organizational chart reflects the most current structure.
troubleshooting: Problem: Changes are not saving → Solution: Ensure all required fields are filled out correctly. Look for validation errors highlighted on the form. If the issue persists, try refreshing the page and re-entering the data.

Problem: Incorrect data displayed → Solution: Verify that you are viewing the correct partner tree node by checking the record ID in the URL. If it's incorrect, navigate back to the main tree view and select the correct node.
help_guidance.getting_started: To begin, navigate to a specific partner tree node from the main Partner Tree listing. This page will load, displaying all editable details for that node. Review the existing information to familiarize yourself with its current configuration. You can then proceed to make any necessary updates to its organizational data or hierarchical relationships.
keyboard_shortcuts: Shift + Tab: Navigate backward between editable fields
Enter: (If applicable) Confirm input in a field or trigger a default action
